events.did: Swam alone in the pool at Lockland University in the early afternoon
events.quote_anchor: VICTOR Vale cut through the water like a knife.

events.did: Found that his eyes were no longer one shade, but two, a strand of violet curled around his pupils
events.quote_anchor: But his eyes were no longer one shade, but two. A strand of violet curled around his pupils, the same vivid color as the liquid in the cartridge.

events.did: Made Dol disappear by twitching the dial in his mind as the dog padded between the rows of lockers
events.quote_anchor: Victor twitched the dial in his mind, the ache in his muscles sharpening enough to make Dol disappear.

events.did: Fetched the disc out of his bag and inhaled the violet mist
events.quote_anchor: Victor fetched the disc out of his bag, and brought it to his lips, inhaled the violet mist.

events.did: Tapped his watch and the timer automatically reset
events.quote_anchor: He tapped his watch, and the timer automatically reset.

events.did: Got a movement notice on his phone from a tracker that had gone beyond its normal range
events.quote_anchor: It was a movement notice, a signal from a tracker that had gone beyond its normal range.

events.did: Saw the dog on the move for the first time in months, beyond the twenty-mile radius he’d set
events.quote_anchor: The dog who, according to his phone, was now on the move for the first time in months. Traveling too far, too fast, beyond the twenty-mile radius he’d set.

events.did: Waited for Mitch while the dot by Mitch’s name stayed gray and offline, and watched the tracker continue moving west
events.quote_anchor: the dot by Mitch’s name stayed gray. Offline. Swiping back to the other app, he watched the tracker continue moving west.

relations.did: Her serum was growing Victor’s heart stronger and edging his limits outward, while she kept tempering his expectations
relations.quote_anchor: Dani was right—his heart was growing stronger, his limits not erased, but edging outward, day by day.

relations.did: Is the black shape that pads among the lockers, a hallucination that has lingered months since Victor rid his body of Haverty’s drug
relations.quote_anchor: It had been months since he rid his body of Haverty’s drug, but the hallucinations lingered.

relations.did: Had brought him back, and Victor had embedded the tracker in the fur just beneath Dol’s collar
relations.quote_anchor: A tracker that he’d embedded in the fur, just beneath Dol’s collar, shortly after Sydney Clarke had brought him back.

relations.did: Had assured Victor only a few hours ago that everything was fine, and was now offline
relations.quote_anchor: Victor swiped over to the message board, where Mitch had assured him, only a few hours ago, that everything was fine.
